title: LINCS replicate supervision benchmark
description: Reproducible code, frozen contracts, compact derived signatures, model checkpoints, result tables, figures, and manuscript files for a compound-disjoint LINCS L1000 benchmark of replicate-supervised representations. The study compares shrinkage linear discriminant analysis with neural and non-learned alternatives across LINCS phases, five additional cell lines, and mechanism and target retrieval among unseen compounds.
